changes.guidance: Pass the actual home directory; keep any existing home.stateVersion override in homeModules.

changes.after: mkHome selects WSL and graphics through environment
changes.before: mkHome always selected WSL CLI composition
changes.guidance: Set environment.wsl = true for an existing WSL home; explicitly set graphical = false for a general CLI home.

changes.after: mkNixos selects environment from system, user and environment; host modules realize the machine
changes.before: mkNixos required name, host.kind, host.stateVersion and profiles
changes.guidance: Move hostname, account, machine, access and storage settings into systemModules; retain effective stateVersion explicitly where it differs from the provider default. Pass the output name in the consumer flake.

changes.after: mkDarwin receives system and user while systemModules own hostname, account, daemon and app selection
changes.before: mkDarwin required host.system, host.hostName and host.user
changes.guidance: Move hostname and account settings to systemModules and retain any effective compatibility value that differs from the provider default.
